verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only covers Plausible's approach to visitor-facing privacy (no cookies, no personal data collected from end-users) — it says nothing about whether the Plausible product itself (e.g., the self-hosted Community Edition or SaaS client) sends telemetry/usage data back to the vendor, nor any setting to disable such telemetry. No documentation, GitHub reference, or community comment addresses an opt-out for the tool's own usage tracking. Missing for 10: any mention of a telemetry/phone-home mechanism in self-hosted CE, and any documented config flag or setting to disable it.
